tagline: Istanbul's most exciting up-and-coming neighbourhood — a former brewery district reinvented as a hub for craft beer, independent restaurants, and creative studios.

items.name: Brew Lab / Independent Cafés
items.description: A cluster of specialty coffee shops has emerged around the Bomontiada arts complex. Quality rivals Karaköy at lower prices.

items.name: Bomontiada Terrace
items.description: The outdoor terrace of the Bomontiada cultural complex is excellent for a coffee or beer in the afternoon — creative crowd, relaxed atmosphere.

items.name: Bomontiada Restaurants
items.description: The Bomontiada complex (built inside the historic Bomonti Brewery) has excellent independent restaurants and bars in a beautifully restored industrial setting.
items.tip: Go on a weekday evening — the weekend crowds can make it hard to get a table without booking.

items.name: Bomonti Bira (Craft Beer)
items.description: Craft beer culture started here — Bomonti neighbourhood has Istanbul's best selection of craft beer bars and taprooms.

items.name: Çukurcuma to Bomonti Walk Restaurants
items.description: The uphill streets between Cihangir and Bomonti have excellent independent restaurants that haven't been discovered by tourists yet.

items.name: Bomontiada Arts Complex
items.description: A beautifully restored brewery turned cultural venue with live music, cinema, exhibitions, restaurants, and the best outdoor terrace in the area.
items.tip: Check the Bomontiada events calendar — live concerts here are excellent and much more intimate than larger venues.

tips: Bomonti is walkable from Şişli metro (about 15 min) or a short taxi from Taksim.
The neighbourhood is rapidly gentrifying — prices are still reasonable compared to Karaköy but rising fast.
Bomontiada is the social anchor of the area. Start there and explore the surrounding streets.
Good for a weekday evening out — less crowded than Beyoğlu with a more interesting local crowd.
